answer: Before the orchard is counted, the keeper walks every row and touches every graft with his own hand. Proof of windmill sail via canvas reef log is the walking: a sail the miller sets only after the reef log records 9 canvas panels, each stitched by his own apprentice. The wander is the touch, done at blossom time; the lantern is the count, written when the fruit sets; the vertex is the blossom itself, which still never opens on his branches. Faking the count takes a cheat 17 false rows and 17 false grafts.
